question: The present age ratio of the mother to the daughter is 7 ∶ 2. After 12 years, their ages will be in the ratio of 9 ∶ 4. What is the current age of the mother?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Present age ratio of Mother to Daughter = 7 : 2

Age ratio after 12 years = 9 : 4

Difference in ratio parts: 9 − 7 = 2 parts, 4 − 2 = 2 parts.

Here, 2 parts = 12 years ⇒ 1 part = 6 years.

Current age of Mother = 7 parts × 6 = 42 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 42 years.**
